title: Website critical review — simple and useful
summary: Four-lens review (prose, factual accuracy, benchmark rigor, UX/API ergonomics) of website/index.html, commissioned 2026-08-08. Confirms the operator's chattiness verdict with line evidence, finds one factually wrong paragraph (complexity-estimate inputs), documents the unavailable-model removal invariant (catalog+policy must go together or ModelEfficiencyMatrix.Default crashes at load), inventories benchmark weaknesses (1 repeat, no Claude coverage, 27% infra-crash rows rendered as capability misses), and derives the TE-32..TE-37 card wave.
